Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of ABBV.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.89 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 39 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2023.
We delivered record revenue of $37.3 billion this quarter, representing 4% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $37.3 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We generated $5.4 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
